name: smwmusic-pok-mon-black-white-embracing-one-s-duty
title: Pokémon Black/White - Embracing One's Duty
description:
A decisive-sounding song that is painfully underplayed in Pokémon Black and White, and even more so in Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, only playing in one short cutscene in both pairs of games.

Use this for climatic scenes and levels! This song can fit cutscenes, major turning points of a story, and - of course - final levels.
